comment: Single source of the Thalyx-Kernel V0 binary interface. The Rust bindings,
the C header and the layout fixtures are generated from this file by
tools/gen_abi.py; nothing in abi/src/generated.rs, abi/src/fixture.rs or
abi/include/thalyx_abi.h is written by hand. vault/architecture/abi.md fixes
the register contract, the 32-byte descriptor header, the 4 KiB descriptor
bound and the 256-byte inline payload bound; this file assigns the numbers
K2 needs and nothing beyond them.
Every structure is little-endian with explicit padding: the generator
refuses a structure that would need implicit padding, so no uninitialised

flags.name: NONBLOCKING
flags.doc: Refuse to wait: an operation that would have blocked returns WOULD_BLOCK instead. Carried in the flags register, never in the descriptor.

entries.name: VERSION_QUERY
entries.doc: Reserved version query. No handle, no descriptor, no authority.

entries.name: INVOKE
entries.doc: Operation addressed to a handle. RDI handle, RSI operation, RDX descriptor, R10 length, R8 flags, R9 deadline.

entries.name: LIMITS_QUERY
entries.doc: Effective interface limits. No handle; writes a Limits descriptor.

entries.name: EXIT
entries.doc: Terminate the calling domain. RSI carries an exit code. Authority over oneself needs no capability.

entries.name: CLOCK_QUERY
entries.doc: Monotonic nanoseconds since boot, in RDX. No handle, no descriptor, no authority: every deadline in this interface is one of these, and a program that cannot read the clock cannot state one.

object_types.name: NONE
object_types.doc: Common operations valid on any typed handle.

object_types.name: SCOPE
object_types.doc: Resource principal: limits, accounting, fence, drain, retire.

object_types.name: DOMAIN
object_types.doc: Protection boundary: address space and capability table.

object_types.name: MEMORY
object_types.doc: Sequence of physical pages with maximum rights and a seal state.

object_types.name: ENDPOINT
object_types.doc: Bounded message queue with one owner and explicit facets.

object_types.name: INVOCATION
object_types.doc: Admitted work: origin, grant, reply, effect admission and resolution.

object_types.name: SIGNAL
object_types.doc: Coalescing bits with a sequence number.

object_types.name: TIMER
object_types.doc: Monotonic expiry bound to a signal.

object_types.name: CONTROL_LOG
object_types.doc: Bounded control-receipt ring with reserved cells.

object_types.name: DEVICE
object_types.doc: A device function the kernel has validated and assigned: its authorised register regions, its interrupt, its DMA grants and its session.

common.name: DERIVE
common.doc: Create attenuated children of this grant.

common.name: TRANSFER
common.doc: Send this capability through IPC or install it into a domain.

common.name: DESTROY
common.doc: Destroy the object itself, not merely the handle.

common.name: ADMIN
common.doc: Fence this grant lineage and read its drain status.

SCOPE.name: SCOPE_CREATE
SCOPE.doc: Factory right: create objects charged to this scope.

SCOPE.name: SCOPE_FENCE
SCOPE.doc: Fence, drain and retire this scope.

SCOPE.name: SCOPE_EXEC
SCOPE.doc: Run work charged to this scope.

DOMAIN.name: DOMAIN_BUILD
DOMAIN.doc: Install maps, capabilities and threads while building.

MEMORY.name: MEMORY_READ
MEMORY.doc: Read the bytes, directly or through a mediated copy.

MEMORY.name: MEMORY_WRITE
MEMORY.doc: Write the bytes. Does not imply MEMORY_READ.

MEMORY.name: MEMORY_MAP
MEMORY.doc: Install a hardware mapping in an authorised domain.

MEMORY.name: MEMORY_SEAL
MEMORY.doc: Withdraw writers and publish the sealed state.

ENDPOINT.name: ENDPOINT_CALL
ENDPOINT.doc: Synchronous call with a one-shot reply.

ENDPOINT.name: ENDPOINT_BIND
ENDPOINT.doc: Administration: mint a send capability carrying a facet.

INVOCATION.name: INVOCATION_EFFECT
INVOCATION.doc: Admit one effect against the original lineage.

INVOCATION.name: INVOCATION_BIND
INVOCATION.doc: Bind a worker's effective scope to this ticket.

SIGNAL.name: SIGNAL_WAIT
SIGNAL.doc: Wait for bits and consume them.

TIMER.name: TIMER_ARM
TIMER.doc: Arm and cancel a monotonic expiry.

CONTROL_LOG.name: LOG_APPEND
CONTROL_LOG.doc: Append a receipt whose origin the kernel stamps.

DEVICE.name: DEVICE_MAP
DEVICE.doc: Map an authorised register region of this device into a domain.

DEVICE.name: DEVICE_IRQ
DEVICE.doc: Bind this device's interrupt to a signal.

DEVICE.name: DEVICE_DMA
DEVICE.doc: Create and revoke DMA grants over memory objects.

DEVICE.name: DEVICE_CONTROL
DEVICE.doc: Bus mastering, reset and the session. Recovery authority, not driver authority.

operations.name: CAP_INSPECT
operations.doc: Report type, rights, lineage and lifetime of one capability.

operations.name: CAP_DERIVE
operations.doc: Create a child grant that only removes rights or brings the deadline forward.

operations.name: CAP_COPY
operations.doc: Install a second handle on the same grant. No new lineage.

operations.name: CAP_CLOSE
operations.doc: Release the local table entry. Never frees the object by itself.

operations.name: CAP_FENCE
operations.doc: Fence this grant and every copy and derivation below it.

operations.name: CAP_DRAIN_STATUS
operations.doc: Report what this grant lineage still holds.

operations.name: SCOPE_CREATE_CHILD
operations.doc: Create a child scope whose every limit fits inside this one.

operations.name: SCOPE_QUERY
operations.doc: Report limits, consumption and debt.

operations.name: SCOPE_SET_LIMITS
operations.doc: Change ceilings of an open scope within the parent's.

operations.name: SCOPE_FENCE
operations.doc: Refuse every new admission under this scope and its descendants.

operations.name: SCOPE_DRAIN_STATUS
operations.doc: Report obligations still inside the closing perimeter.

operations.name: SCOPE_RETIRE
operations.doc: Release resources once quiescent; refused while obligations remain.

operations.name: SCOPE_CREATE_DOMAIN
operations.doc: Build a domain from a validated image object. Leaves it unable to execute.

operations.name: SCOPE_CREATE_MEMORY
operations.doc: Reserve pages and create a memory object sponsored by this scope.

operations.name: SCOPE_CREATE_ENDPOINT
operations.doc: Create an endpoint with a fixed queue capacity.

operations.name: SCOPE_CREATE_SIGNAL
operations.doc: Create a coalescing signal.

operations.name: SCOPE_CREATE_TIMER
operations.doc: Create a timer bound to a signal and bits.

operations.name: DOMAIN_MAP
operations.doc: Install a mapping of a memory object in this domain.

operations.name: DOMAIN_UNMAP
operations.doc: Withdraw a mapping and its translations.

operations.name: DOMAIN_INSTALL_CAP
operations.doc: Install a capability into a chosen slot of the domain's table.

operations.name: DOMAIN_ADD_THREAD
operations.doc: Create a thread with an entry point and a mapped stack.

operations.name: DOMAIN_SET_FAULT_CHANNEL
operations.doc: Install the supervisor channel a fault is reported on, with its reserved record.

operations.name: DOMAIN_ACTIVATE
operations.doc: The single transition after which user code may run.

operations.name: DOMAIN_TERMINATE
operations.doc: Stop every thread and withdraw direct access. Retained obligations survive.

operations.name: DOMAIN_QUERY
operations.doc: Report lifecycle state, faults and exit.

operations.name: MEMORY_QUERY
operations.doc: Report size, maximum rights, seal state and sponsorship.

operations.name: MEMORY_COPY
operations.doc: Copy bytes from a readable object into this writable one.

operations.name: MEMORY_SEAL
operations.doc: Refuse new writers, withdraw existing ones, then publish the seal.

operations.name: MEMORY_WRITE
operations.doc: Mediated write that reveals none of the previous bytes.

operations.name: MEMORY_READ
operations.doc: Mediated read of a bounded range.

operations.name: ENDPOINT_BIND_FACET
operations.doc: Mint a send capability carrying an immutable facet.

operations.name: ENDPOINT_CALL
operations.doc: Admit a message and block for its one-shot reply.

operations.name: ENDPOINT_SEND
operations.doc: Admit a message without blocking for a reply.

operations.name: ENDPOINT_RECEIVE
operations.doc: Take the oldest admitted message with its authenticated header.

operations.name: ENDPOINT_QUERY
operations.doc: Report queue occupancy and epoch.

operations.name: INVOCATION_REPLY
operations.doc: Consume the reply exactly once.

operations.name: INVOCATION_BEGIN_EFFECT
operations.doc: Revalidate the admitting lineage and reserve closure capacity.

operations.name: INVOCATION_RESOLVE
operations.doc: Discharge the obligation with an explicit outcome.

operations.name: INVOCATION_QUERY
operations.doc: Report origin, cancellation and effect state.

operations.name: INVOCATION_BIND_WORKER
operations.doc: Charge this thread's work to the invocation's originating scope.

operations.name: INVOCATION_UNBIND_WORKER
operations.doc: Return the thread to its owning scope.

operations.name: SIGNAL_RAISE
operations.doc: Set bits and advance the sequence.

operations.name: SIGNAL_WAIT
operations.doc: Wait for any masked bit, consuming what was observed.

operations.name: SIGNAL_QUERY
operations.doc: Read bits and sequence without waiting.

operations.name: TIMER_ARM
operations.doc: Arm a monotonic expiry.

operations.name: TIMER_CANCEL
operations.doc: Cancel an armed expiry.

operations.name: TIMER_QUERY
operations.doc: Report the armed deadline and fire count.

operations.name: LOG_READ
operations.doc: Read a bounded batch of receipts and the loss count.

operations.name: LOG_APPEND
operations.doc: Append a receipt. Origin and time come from the kernel, never from the payload.

operations.name: LOG_ACK
operations.doc: Acknowledge consumption up to a sequence.

operations.name: LOG_QUERY
operations.doc: Report capacity, reservation and loss.

operations.name: DEVICE_QUERY
operations.doc: Report identity, state, authorised regions and isolation profile.

operations.name: DEVICE_MAP_REGION
operations.doc: Map one authorised region of this device into a domain, uncacheable.

operations.name: DEVICE_UNMAP_REGION
operations.doc: Withdraw that mapping and wait for every processor to retire it.

operations.name: DEVICE_BIND_IRQ
operations.doc: Route one device interrupt to a signal. The kernel programs the vector; the driver never reaches the table that holds it.

operations.name: DEVICE_SET_MASTER
operations.doc: Enable or disable bus mastering. Recovery authority, deliberately separate from the driver's.

operations.name: DEVICE_DMA_MAP
operations.doc: Pin pages and grant the device access to them under the current session.

operations.name: DEVICE_DMA_UNMAP
operations.doc: Revoke a grant once the device can no longer be issuing requests against it.

operations.name: DEVICE_RESET
operations.doc: Stop the device, revoke what it could reach and start a new session.

errors.name: OK
errors.doc: Operation completed.

errors.name: UNSUPPORTED_ENTRY
errors.doc: The entry identifier is not implemented by this revision.

errors.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
errors.doc: Structurally rejected before any effect.

errors.name: INCOMPATIBLE_VERSION
errors.doc: Descriptor major version not supported. Rejected before effects.

errors.name: INVALID_HANDLE
errors.doc: No live entry names that index and generation.

errors.name: WRONG_TYPE
errors.doc: The operation does not belong to the object's type.

errors.name: INSUFFICIENT_RIGHTS
errors.doc: The grant does not carry every right the operation requires.

errors.name: EXPIRED
errors.doc: A monotonic deadline in the lineage has passed.

errors.name: SCOPE_CLOSED
errors.doc: A scope or grant in the lineage is fenced.

errors.name: LIMIT_EXHAUSTED
errors.doc: A reservation did not fit in every ancestor.

errors.name: QUEUE_FULL
errors.doc: The bounded queue has no room and no slot is reserved for this traffic.

errors.name: INVALID_ADDRESS
errors.doc: A user address is unmapped or lacks the required rights.

errors.name: PEER_DEAD
errors.doc: The other end of the operation no longer exists.

errors.name: CANCELLED
errors.doc: The wait ended because its authority was closed.

errors.name: PENDING
errors.doc: The obligation is admitted and not yet resolved.

errors.name: WOULD_BLOCK
errors.doc: The operation would have waited and no deadline allowed it.

errors.name: TIMED_OUT
errors.doc: The deadline passed before the wait completed. Not a proof of absence of effect.

errors.name: ALREADY_RESOLVED
errors.doc: A one-shot object was already consumed.

errors.name: STATE_CONFLICT
errors.doc: The object's state forbids the operation.

errors.name: DRAIN_INCOMPLETE
errors.doc: Obligations remain inside the closing perimeter.

errors.name: NOT_SUPPORTED
errors.doc: The operation exists but this revision does not implement it.

errors.name: UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE
errors.doc: The isolation profile the caller required is not the one this machine can satisfy. Refused before any effect, never downgraded silently.

structs.name: DescriptorHeader
structs.doc: Common descriptor header fixed by vault/architecture/abi.md.

fields.name: major
fields.doc: Descriptor major version. A mismatch is refused before effects.

fields.name: minor
fields.doc: Descriptor minor version.

fields.name: opcode
fields.doc: Operation selector. Must equal the operation passed in RSI.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: Operation flags. Unknown bits are refused, never ignored.

fields.name: total_len
fields.doc: Whole descriptor length including this header. Must equal R10.

fields.name: cookie
fields.doc: Client correlation value. Not authorisation and not durable dedupe.

fields.name: reserved
fields.doc: Reserved, must be zero.

structs.name: Limits
structs.doc: Effective interface limits reported by the LIMITS_QUERY entry.

fields.name: cpus_online
fields.doc: Processors that completed the kernel's handshake and can be scheduled on.

structs.name: CapInfo
structs.doc: What one capability names and what its lineage still permits.

fields.name: rights
fields.doc: Effective rights: never larger than any ancestor's.

fields.name: lineage_state
fields.doc: CapLineage: what the lineage between this grant and its root still permits.

fields.name: deadline_ns
fields.doc: Zero means no deadline.

fields.name: facet
fields.doc: Immutable endpoint facet, zero when the grant carries none.

structs.name: DeriveRequest
structs.doc: Attenuation request. Rights outside the parent's and deadlines beyond it are refused.

fields.name: rights_mask
fields.doc: Requested rights. Must be a subset of the parent's.

fields.name: deadline_ns
fields.doc: Zero keeps the parent's deadline; otherwise must not be later.

fields.name: life_scope
fields.doc: Optional extra scope handle bounding the child's life. Zero for none.

structs.name: ScopeLimits
structs.doc: Ceilings of one scope. Every one must fit inside every ancestor's.

fields.name: cpu_budget_ns
fields.doc: Aggregate execution per fixed window.

fields.name: closure_reserve_ns
fields.doc: Recovery reserve untouchable by ordinary work.

structs.name: ScopeCreateRequest
structs.doc: Create a child scope with its own ceilings and a diagnostic label.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Diagnostic only. A name grants nothing.

structs.name: ScopeInfo
structs.doc: Limits, consumption and debt of one scope.

structs.name: DrainReport
structs.doc: What a closing perimeter still holds. A timeout is not quiescence.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: Stable progress token; equal tokens mean no progress was made.

structs.name: DomainCreateRequest
structs.doc: Build a domain from an image object the caller may read.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Diagnostic only.

structs.name: MapRequest
structs.doc: Install one mapping. Rights are checked against the capability and the platform.

fields.name: rights
fields.doc: Subset of MEMORY_READ/WRITE/EXECUTE.

structs.name: UnmapRequest
structs.doc: Withdraw a mapping range and its translations.

structs.name: InstallCapRequest
structs.doc: Install a capability into a building domain's table at a chosen slot.

fields.name: deadline_ns
fields.doc: Zero keeps the source deadline.

fields.name: rights_mask
fields.doc: Attenuation applied while installing; never an amplification.

structs.name: ThreadCreateRequest
structs.doc: Create one thread of a building domain.

fields.name: stack_top
fields.doc: Must be inside a writable mapping of the domain.

fields.name: argument
fields.doc: Passed to the thread in RDI.

structs.name: FaultChannelRequest
structs.doc: Endpoint a fault of this domain is reported on, with a record reserved in advance.

structs.name: DomainInfo
structs.doc: Lifecycle, faults and exit of one domain.

fields.name: entry_point
fields.doc: Entry point the image declared. An authority adding a thread needs it, and the domain's creator is the only one that can be told.

structs.name: MemoryCreateRequest
structs.doc: Reserve resident pages before the object becomes visible.

structs.name: MemoryInfo
structs.doc: Size, maximum rights, seal state and alias counts of one memory object.

structs.name: MemoryCopyRequest
structs.doc: Copy a bounded range between two memory objects.

structs.name: MemoryBytes
structs.doc: Mediated read or write of a bounded range.

structs.name: EndpointCreateRequest
structs.doc: Create an endpoint with fixed queue capacity.

structs.name: BindFacetRequest
structs.doc: Administration that mints a send capability bound to one logical object.

fields.name: facet
fields.doc: Opaque, immutable, unique within the endpoint epoch.

structs.name: EndpointInfo
structs.doc: Queue occupancy and epoch of one endpoint.

structs.name: MessageHeader
structs.doc: Built by the kernel. A payload cannot overwrite any field of it.

structs.name: SendRequest
structs.doc: One message: bounded payload plus at most four capabilities, all or nothing.

fields.name: cap_ops
fields.doc: COPY or MOVE per capability.

structs.name: CallResult
structs.doc: Reply of a synchronous call. Absence of a reply never means absence of effect.

structs.name: ReceiveResult
structs.doc: An authenticated header, untrusted bytes and installed capabilities.

structs.name: ReplyRequest
structs.doc: One-shot reply bound to one invocation.

structs.name: EffectRequest
structs.doc: Effect admission: the same lineage checked again under the same synchronisation.

fields.name: closure_reserve_ns
fields.doc: Recovery budget reserved before the effect is permitted.

structs.name: ResolveRequest
structs.doc: Discharge of a retained obligation with an explicit outcome.

structs.name: InvocationInfo
structs.doc: Origin, cancellation and effect state of admitted work.

structs.name: SignalBits
structs.doc: Bit set raised or waited on.

structs.name: SignalInfo
structs.doc: Coalesced bits with a sequence, so a consumer can re-arm without losing a race.

structs.name: TimerCreateRequest
structs.doc: Timer bound to the signal and bits it raises on expiry.

structs.name: TimerArmRequest
structs.doc: Monotonic expiry.

structs.name: TimerInfo
structs.doc: Armed deadline and fire count.

structs.name: ReceiptRecord
structs.doc: One control receipt. Origin and time are the kernel's; a and b are the caller's untrusted values.

structs.name: LogReadResult
structs.doc: A bounded batch of receipts and an explicit loss count.

fields.name: lost
fields.doc: Receipts dropped since the last read. Coverage is never assumed complete.

structs.name: LogAppendRequest
structs.doc: Service note. The kernel stamps origin; the payload cannot claim another.

fields.name: claimed_origin_domain_id
fields.doc: Ignored by the kernel. Present so a forged origin can be observed being overwritten.

structs.name: LogAckRequest
structs.doc: Acknowledge consumption up to a sequence.

structs.name: LogInfo
structs.doc: Capacity, reservation and loss of one control log.

structs.name: FaultReport
structs.doc: Bounded fault payload delivered to a supervisor. Carries no kernel address.

structs.name: DeviceRegion
structs.doc: One register region of a device the driver may be given. Offsets and lengths are the kernel's, validated against the base address register they live in.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: DeviceRegionKind.

fields.name: bar
fields.doc: Base address register the region lives in.

fields.name: offset
fields.doc: Byte offset inside that register's window.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: Bit 0: currently mapped into some domain.

fields.name: notify_off_multiplier
fields.doc: Meaningful for the notify region only.

structs.name: DeviceInfo
structs.doc: Identity, state, authorised regions and isolation profile of one assigned device.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: DeviceState.

fields.name: session
fields.doc: Incremented by every reset. An operation naming an older session is refused.

fields.name: bdf
fields.doc: Segment, bus, device and function packed as (segment<<16)|(bus<<8)|(device<<3)|function.

fields.name: class_code
fields.doc: Class, subclass and programming interface.

fields.name: irq_bound
fields.doc: Interrupts currently bound to a signal.

fields.name: dma_profile
fields.doc: DmaProfile: what this machine can actually sustain, not what was asked for.

fields.name: iommu_described
fields.doc: Firmware describes a remapping unit.

fields.name: iommu_translating
fields.doc: This kernel has translation enabled for this device's group.

fields.name: access_platform
fields.doc: The device negotiated platform-mediated access for its DMA.

fields.name: bus_master
fields.doc: Bus mastering is enabled in configuration space.

fields.name: dma_address_bits
fields.doc: Address width the kernel will hand the device.

fields.name: isolation_group
fields.doc: Group this device shares an isolation boundary with.

fields.name: group_members
fields.doc: Functions in that group. A group with more than one member is not a boundary of its own.

structs.name: DeviceMapRequest
structs.doc: Install or withdraw a mapping of one device region in a domain.

fields.name: domain_handle
fields.doc: Domain to map into; needs DOMAIN_BUILD through this handle.

fields.name: session
fields.doc: Session the caller believes the device is in.

structs.name: DeviceIrqRequest
structs.doc: Bind one device interrupt to a signal.

fields.name: signal_handle
fields.doc: Signal to raise; needs SIGNAL_RAISE through this handle.

fields.name: bits
fields.doc: Bits to raise when the interrupt arrives.

fields.name: vector_index
fields.doc: Interrupt of the device to bind.

structs.name: DeviceControlRequest
structs.doc: Change bus mastering, or reset the device and its session.

fields.name: enable
fields.doc: For bus mastering: one to enable, zero to disable.

structs.name: DmaMapRequest
structs.doc: Grant a device access to the pages of a memory object.

fields.name: memory_handle
fields.doc: Memory object to pin; needs the read or write rights being granted.

fields.name: rights
fields.doc: Subset of MEMORY_READ and MEMORY_WRITE, from the device's point of view.

fields.name: required_profile
fields.doc: DmaProfile the caller requires. A machine that cannot sustain it refuses with UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE rather than granting a weaker one.

structs.name: DmaGrantInfo
structs.doc: What a device may reach, and under which session.

fields.name: iova
fields.doc: Address the device uses. Not a CPU address and not derived from one by arithmetic.

fields.name: profile
fields.doc: DmaProfile actually granted.

structs.name: DmaUnmapRequest
structs.doc: Revoke a DMA grant. Refused while the device can still be issuing requests against it.

boot_slots.name: SELF_DOMAIN
boot_slots.doc: The supervisor's own domain: build, map, install and activate children through it.

boot_slots.name: SELF_SCOPE
boot_slots.doc: The supervisor's scope: the only factory authority it starts with.

boot_slots.name: CONTROL_LOG
boot_slots.doc: Control receipts: read, append and acknowledge.

boot_slots.name: FIRST_DEVICE
boot_slots.doc: First assigned device, if the machine has one. Devices follow in enumeration order; DEVICE_QUERY reports which.

boot_slots.name: FIRST_MODULE
boot_slots.doc: First sealed image object. Modules follow in package order; MEMORY_QUERY reports the label.
